components.gap: Construction or argument not written in full. annex:p15.conditional-existence restricts P to G and applies the proved Radon-Nikodym theorem on (Omega,G,P|_G) (annex lines 23-31), which yields nu_pm(A) = integral over A of Z_pm with respect to P|_G. Lines 32-39 then assert that Z_pm are integrable with integrals EX^pm and that int_A Z dP = nu_+(A) - nu_-(A), i.e. they silently replace P|_G-integrals of G-measurable functions by P-integrals. No step or citation supplies that identification (it would follow from thm:p15-expectation-law-integral applied to the identity map (Omega,F0)->(Omega,G), whose law is P|_G, or from G-simple approximation by thm:p15-measurable-limits plus monotone convergence on both spaces), and no handbook result states it. So the argument that the constructed Z meets the P-integral identity and P-integrability demanded by def:p15-general-conditional-expectation has an unwritten step. All other elements are present: integrability and E|Z|<=E|X| (annex 5-14), a.e. uniqueness (15-21), the source X+/X- construction (23-39, Durrett p. 207), no completion (41), worked a.e.-uniqueness boundary (body 365-371, annex 727-739).

defect_observations.detail: Existence proof works on (Omega,G,P|_G) but states the density identities with dP; the identity int_A f d(P|_G) = int_A f dP for G-measurable f>=0 is neither written nor cited anywhere in the handbook. One sentence citing thm:p15-expectation-law-integral for the identity map (Omega,F0)->(Omega,G), or G-simple approximation plus monotone convergence, would close it.
